records.source: You probably wouldn't like it inside my cabin. It's dark and full of spiders.$s
records.translation: 你大概不會喜歡我的木屋。裡面昏暗，又到處都是蜘蛛。$s

records.source: Please excuse the sorry state of my cabin.
records.translation: 請原諒我這間木屋的寒酸模樣。

records.source: Some people are shy. Keep showing interest in them and they'll get comfortable around you.#$e#Everyone likes to have friends, even that grumpy blacksmith.
records.translation: 有些人比較害羞。只要持續對他們表現出興趣，他們就會漸漸在你身邊感到自在。#$e#每個人都喜歡擁有朋友，就連那位脾氣暴躁的鐵匠也一樣。

records.source: Hello. I hope your new farming life is panning out as you'd hoped?
records.translation: 你好。希望嶄新的農場生活正如你所願地發展？

records.source: Oh, @! I was hoping you'd show up.#$e#It's always a pleasure to see you.$h
records.translation: 喔，@！我正盼著你出現。#$e#見到你總是令人愉快。$h

records.source: Mystery, huh? It's definitely an exciting genre. I'll remember that.
records.translation: 推理故事，嗯？這確實是個令人興奮的類型。我會記住。

records.source: Ah, one of the classic genres. I'll remember that.
records.translation: 啊，經典類型之一。我會記住。

records.source: I would've never guessed! I suppose even those of the 'earthiest' profession sometimes have their heads in the stars.$h#$b#I'll remember that.
records.translation: 我絕對猜不到！看來即使從事最「接地氣」職業的人，有時也會仰望星空。$h#$b#我會記住。

records.source: ... I was worried you might not feel this way about another man.$l^So am I.$l
records.translation: ……我還擔心你不會對另一個男人抱有這種感情。$l^我也是。$l

records.source: Oh! I'm so sorry.$8%fork
records.translation: 喔！真的很抱歉。$8%fork

records.source: Well...okay.#$b#Here's to @!
That's a great idea!$h#$b#Here's to us!
records.translation: 好主意！$h#$b#敬我們！

records.source: Hmmph...forget it.$a
records.translation: 哼……算了。$a

records.source: Ah, to a harmonious future for the community... what a virtuous idea.#$b#Here's to Pelican Town!
records.translation: 啊，為社區和諧的未來乾杯……多麼高尚的想法。#$b#敬鵜鶘鎮！

records.source: A gentle little sunbeam woke me up this morning. I've never felt so refreshed.$u#$e#I'm sorry if that isn't very interesting to you.
records.translation: 今早，一縷溫柔的陽光喚醒了我。我從未感到如此神清氣爽。$u#$e#如果你覺得這不太有趣，還請見諒。

records.source: I know that I am kind of an 'oddball'.#$e#I hope you don't mind.$h
records.translation: 我知道自己算是個「怪人」。#$e#希望你不介意。$h

records.source: @, I know you have faith in my abilities as a writer. That means a lot to me.$h
records.translation: @，我知道你相信我的寫作能力。這對我意義重大。$h

records.source: I've encountered some beautiful shells in front of my house.#$e#I would imagine the rarer varieties to be quite valuable.
records.translation: 我在屋前發現了一些美麗的貝殼。#$e#我想，稀有品種應該相當珍貴。

records.source: I write in hopes of connecting with others through time and space.$u#$e#*sigh*...times are changing, though. People don't read anymore.$s
records.translation: 我提筆寫作，希望能跨越時空與他人產生連結。$u#$e#*嘆氣*……不過時代正在改變。人們已經不讀書了。$s

records.source: It must be satisfying to follow your crop from seed to harvest.#$e#It's as if your essence is infused into the fruit.$u
records.translation: 看著作物從種子一路成長到收穫，一定很有成就感。#$e#彷彿你的靈魂精髓也融入了果實。$u

records.source: Oh dear! My shoes are filled with sand.$s#$e#That's the trouble with living on the beach.
records.translation: 喔，天啊！我的鞋子裡全是沙。$s#$e#這就是住在海灘的麻煩之處。

records.source: @? You look puzzled.#$b#I guess the hot summer air can make us a little dizzy.
records.translation: @？你看起來很困惑。#$b#我想炎熱的夏日空氣會讓人有點暈眩。

records.source: The sun is angry today... My skin is a bit too delicate, I'm afraid.
records.translation: 今天的太陽怒氣沖沖……恐怕我的皮膚有些太嬌嫩了。

records.source: You came all the way here just to talk to me? How kind.$h
records.translation: 你大老遠來到這裡，只為了和我說話？真是體貼。$h

records.source: Visit my cabin whenever you like. I could use the company.$h
records.translation: 隨時都可以來我的木屋。我正需要有人作伴。$h

records.source: Hello @.#$e#Make sure and take breaks from your work now and then.
records.translation: 你好，@。#$e#工作時一定要偶爾休息一下。

records.source: Come visit me if you need a break from your labors.$h#$e#I'm usually at my house.
records.translation: 如果工作累了，就來拜訪我吧。$h#$e#我通常都在家。

records.source: It's been said that a pirate's ship, full of plundered gold, shipwrecked here a long time ago.
records.translation: 據說很久以前，有一艘載滿掠奪黃金的海盜船在這裡失事。

records.source: Let's not get in a tizzy, now... Gus! I propose a round of drinks to settle the nerves!%noturn
records.translation: 現在先別慌張……格斯！我提議大家喝上一輪，安定一下情緒！%noturn

records.source: Ah, yet another unique day in the valley. Stimulating, to say the least!
records.translation: 啊，山谷裡又迎來了獨一無二的一天。至少可以說，令人精神振奮！

records.source: @, I was just thinking about you.$l#$e#Maybe you sensed it.$h#$e#So! Tell me about your day.
records.translation: @，我剛才正在想你。$l#$e#也許你感應到了。$h#$e#那麼！跟我說說你今天過得如何。

records.source: I wouldn't mind trying my hand at farming.#$e#The quiet atmosphere of a farm might be a good source of literary inspiration, don't you think?$h
records.translation: 我不介意嘗試務農。#$e#農場的寧靜氛圍也許是文學靈感的良好來源，你不覺得嗎？$h

records.source: Oh dear! A tiny crab appears to have made his home in my shirt pocket.$l#$e#That's the trouble with living on the beach.
records.translation: 喔，天啊！一隻小螃蟹似乎把我的襯衫口袋當成了家。$l#$e#這就是住在海灘的麻煩之處。

records.source: My legs are stiff from sitting at my writing desk all night.$s#$e#Sometimes I envy you, @.
records.translation: 整夜坐在寫字桌前，讓我的雙腿變得僵硬。$s#$e#有時我很羨慕你，@。

records.source: My legs are stiff from sitting at my writing desk all morning.$s
records.translation: 整個早晨坐在寫字桌前，讓我的雙腿變得僵硬。$s

records.source: @, when you're around... I feel unusually creative.$l#$e#I know... strange, but it's true.
records.translation: @，只要你在身邊……我就會湧現異乎尋常的創作力。$l#$e#我知道……很奇怪，但這是真的。

records.source: It gets windy this time of year. Marvelous!$h
records.translation: 每年這時候都會颳起風。妙極了！$h

records.source: I have to remember to water my plants today. And not with sea water this time!
records.translation: 今天得記得替植物澆水。而且這次不能用海水！

records.source: You've come to visit me in the cold?#$e#I could do with a respite from my lonely labors.
records.translation: 你冒著嚴寒來拜訪我？#$e#我正需要暫時放下孤獨的工作，喘口氣。

records.source: @, you've trudged through the snow to visit me?#$e#I'm honored!$h
records.translation: @，你踏著積雪來拜訪我？#$e#我深感榮幸！$h

records.source: People have scraped a living off the sea for thousands of years.#$e#I just go to the grocery store.$s
records.translation: 數千年來，人們一直靠海討生活。#$e#我只會去雜貨店。$s

records.source: @, I had a feeling that you would show up.#$e#Perhaps we're connected by an other-worldly thread.$l
records.translation: @，我有種你會出現的預感。#$e#也許我們被一條超越塵世的絲線連結在一起。$l

records.source: A day can never be boring when you follow the whims of your imagination.$u#$e#Sorry, am I babbling on about nonsense?
records.translation: 只要追隨想像力的奇思妙想，一天永遠不會無聊。$u#$e#抱歉，我是不是又在胡言亂語？

records.source: Breathe deeply. Do you notice it? That's the smell of the sea.#$e#How does it make you feel?
records.translation: 深呼吸。你注意到了嗎？那是大海的氣味。#$e#它帶給你什麼感受？

records.source: Breathe deeply. Do you notice it? That's the smell of the sea.#$e#Whenever I smell the sea, it reminds me of my youth. The ocean really impressed me as a child.
records.translation: 深呼吸。你注意到了嗎？那是大海的氣味。#$e#每當聞到海的氣息，我就會想起青春歲月。孩提時代的我深深為海洋震撼。

records.source: I have to brush my hair daily, or else it'll clump up into messy knots.#$e#It's a lot of work.#$e#I'm surprised I haven't just shaved it off in a fit of passion.$h#$e#I suppose I am too vain.
records.translation: 我每天都得梳理頭髮，否則就會結成凌亂的一團。#$e#這很費工夫。#$e#真驚訝自己從未在一時衝動下把它剃光。$h#$e#我想自己還是太愛美了。

records.source: I've been doing little indoor exercises, since it's often too cold to go out.#$e#Sorry if it's a little humid in the cabin.$s
records.translation: 外面往往冷得不宜出門，所以我一直在室內做些簡單運動。#$e#如果木屋裡有點潮溼，還請見諒。$s

records.source: I really should scrub my floorboards today. I think an algae is starting to form.$s#$e#Do you make time for cleaning?
records.translation: 今天真的該刷洗地板了。我想上面開始長藻了。$s#$e#你會抽時間打掃嗎？
